record.question: Which prior occupancy order does STF-16-2026-09 supersede?
record.reason: Signed PDF footer names STF-16-2024-10 (July 29, 2024); alert summary names STF-16-2022-06 (July 28, 2022). Preserve both statements. This does not resolve trailhead-specific one-night guidance or classify a camping site as developed/undeveloped.
